facts.fact: 门牌变名：回房发现铭牌已换（DAVID SAWYER→NOAH PETERS）——「Is that supposed to be me? That doesn't make any sense. A person can't have two names, can they? Make up your mind, PAA—am I supposed to be David Sawyer or Noah Peters?」——试穿两名的结论：「Both names feel as though they belong to someone else. David Sawyer and Noah Peters, different variations on the same bum theme. A disguise someone dressed me up in while I was sleeping…The hospital's latest attempt to keep me sick instead of making me better. Which I'm starting to realize is the whole point of Public Access Afterworld.」

监狱命名学：整夜醒躺——「Nothing ever happens.」×2——循环日程（night sleep→first meal→day sleep→therapy）永不 aging/dying/family/love/character arcs——「The only place anything like that's ever allowed to happen is inside the TV shows we grow in our bodies.」——残酷笑话（「sadistic consolation prize for not being allowed to live an actual life」）——「How did I ever let them convince me that I was sick?…Getting strapped down and having my most personal parts converted into television and sucked out of me so they can become someone else's entertainment up above? Being made part of some interdimensional grid that I never consented to help power?——That's not therapy. That's a factory farm. That's forced extraction. That's rape. What they're doing to us here is rape. PAA isn't a hospital. It's a prison.」——新语言：「this isn't my 'room'…It's my cell. Those aren't my 'chaperones.' They're my prison guards.」

ESP 开门：夜训 stray signals（「I can control them. Can train those signal intrusions to help me wake up. It's as easy as thinking」）——「I know how I sound. Like a crazy person…A mental patient. But I'm not crazy. I'm stronger than this place.——Maybe this is my superpower. Controlling washer-dryers at the fucking laundromat.——One last bender, so let's make it count.」——盯门假装 ESP：「in that exact moment when I believe it, the door to my cell malfunctions and shoots open. I make it happen, key cards be damned. The paneling fritzes and pops like an overheated toaster.」——夜巡：走廊无人（static men off duty、sleeping inside patients' skulls）——考虑过解锁全部病友门但「useless, at least for now…They haven't received my signal intrusion yet. They haven't woken up. I'll need to reach them another way. I'll need to find them where they're trapped.」——下 ramp 至空治疗室

纽约愿望：空治疗室 cavernous（egg 凸出）——想独自躺上水泥台「greet the airwaves above on my own terms…feel the wonder of a child in the planetarium」——不插管 stay inside myself——看 broadcast 游动、看穿 choppy broadcasts——「The shows beneath the shows. The hidden broadcasts nestled under one hundred years of TV history.」——愿望段：「I want to see the lights of New York City one more time…cool spring night in the West Village, near Christopher Street. And I promise if you let me see it again, I won't tell anyone about it. I won't take a picture on my smartphone or turn it into a TV show or feed it to the sickness at all. I just want to experience it. Unwitnessed. Unrecorded. Please let me see the lights of New York City one more time…」

图层下的群像：go soft 双视（double-visioned）——锅铲女摸镜头欲触上方孙辈、轮椅女孩在 Flushing 藏故事、In-N-Out 千次午餐 rush 的酸肩、conjunctivitis 女孩欢迎 Pink Eye TV 观众——「I know her name. I sense her glow.」——点名册：Chloe Edmonds（Allen Park, MI）/Angela（Des Moines）/Josie（Flushing）/Randy（L.A. County）/Willa Fischer（yellow dress、frail、burnt pan 洗到流血）——「That's Lucille Ball. That's Mary Tyler Moore. That's the skunked underimage of every TV icon. What's always been lurking beneath their signal.」——「Find the receiver. Make it real.」×2——Lil' Angus special episode（inflamed spleen 般鼓胀的 endless rerun）+ Creepy Coach Horton/「Just one more question…Can I still join the basketball team next season?」——Laugh track. Freeze-frame. Script Girl.——「Red static surrounds this very special episode, slithering its electric tendrils upwards.」——潜入 voice 下找名字：「That's Erin Morrison. Former future valedictorian from Hartsdale, New York. Alone, underneath the stars, lost somewhere in the cinematic universe.」——脑内声音提醒：「If you can save only one, make it her.」

最后拼图：回 cell 前再深一层——「Past Chloe and Randy and Willa and Erin, past the red static. I go past David Sawyer and Noah Peters. I leave behind those fake names they plastered on the doors of my cells.」——一生回放：Greyhound 到 Austin/Cherrywood 冰茶/Lily 沙发/Cheer Up Charlies 的 early twenties bender——「The night I said my real name out loud for the first time. Those early months of becoming, when everything felt so possible it was utterly terrifying.」——Abel（「looked at me like I was already the girl I hoped to someday become. No one had ever looked at me like that, and I mistook the feeling for love」）——tofu scramble/foot rubs/48 号 GoT 仿品——「I wasn't done becoming myself yet.」——Gap 等烂工作/Lubbock/Jules 掷高尔夫球/第二辆 Greyhound/暴力与 wasabi peas 混脑浆/沙漠政府垃圾+三猴牌/pantry（「where he tried to turn me back into the imaginary friend inside his head…on the other end of a one-way mirror」）——「I'm telling myself the story of my life.（×2 第二遍加 instead of living it）」——入 airwaves 换机位、enter the glow——「I become her, like I'm becoming a character in a TV show. It's easy. Natural, because everything is natural. And this time I don't need any nameplate on the door to let me know exactly who I am. The person who I'm becoming, who I'll always be becoming.——I'm Bethany Peters. Like Buffy from Buffy, or Xena from Xena, or Dr. Quinn, Medicine Woman, from Dr. Quinn, Medicine Woman. I'm the hero of this particular TV show.——It hurts to remember, because the remembering always hurts.」
